entities.summary: Alexander "Sasha" Abramovich Belavin is a Russian physicist, known for his contributions to string theory. He is a professor at the Independent University of Moscow and a researcher at the Landau Institute for Theoretical Physics. He is also a member of the editorial board of the Moscow Mathematical Journal.
